globalInvariants: Older revisions and superseded operations never replace newer UI state
Validation, preview, and pending approval are non-mutating
Agent-authored persistent markup is tagged SourceType.AI
A failed or cancelled atomic mutation leaves no partial program changes
Every committed agent mutation has evidence, approval, audit, and one named undo item

scenarios.title: Connected navigation and layered highlights
assertions: Latest request wins after rapid navigation
Token and instruction selections map to the fixture address set in both directions
Pinned and locked views retain independent identity and freshness
Removing the agent highlight preserves other highlight owners

scenarios.title: Transactional type recovery and semantic propagation
assertions: Invalid and cancelled edits are non-mutating
Approved edits create one atomic undo item
All dependent views refresh from the committed revision
AI markup never silently overwrites user or imported markup

scenarios.title: Import and analysis cancellation and recovery
assertions: Progress is monotonic and phase-labeled
Cancellation leaves an explicitly partial but valid model
Retry is idempotent and produces the deterministic completed model
Late events from closed, cancelled, or superseded operations are ignored

scenarios.title: Evidence-backed batch change plan
assertions: Every claim and proposed row links to concrete evidence
A revision race blocks execution before a transaction opens
Partial approval changes only selected rows but commits atomically
Audit and undo describe the exact approved mutation
Read-only headless execution is not treated as an external-I/O sandbox

scenarios.title: Semantic graph state versus layout state
assertions: Refresh preserves geometry while Relayout preserves semantic identity
Group and ungroup restore the fixture graph
Overlay ownership and lifetimes remain independent
Path-to-selection equals the fixture code-unit address set

scenarios.title: Program Diff and Version Tracking review
assertions: Program identities and merge direction remain visible
Accepting a match atomically blocks competitors
Ambiguous matches are never auto-applied
Clear and Undo restore destination markup and match state

scenarios.title: Debugger coordinates, time travel, and emulator-first changes
assertions: Coordinate changes update dependent views atomically
Past, stale, changed, and unmapped values are distinguishable
Live writes require both the correct control mode and scoped approval
Target state is revalidated after approval
External target effects are never represented as safely undoable

scenarios.title: Persistent topology and agent-owned evidence workspace
assertions: Exactly one focused provider owns local actions
Provider topology and split ratios round-trip within tolerance
Persistent and transient provider lifecycles remain distinct
Closing the agent workspace restores the user layout and focus
